style.description: The first version's look: bordered cover tiles, uppercase black headings, a wordmark and a three-column player. Pairs with the Standard v1 colours; its toolbar arrangement is the Standard v1 layout, which any look can use.

palettes.label: Standard v1
palettes.source: The first version of the app: Tailwind zinc on near-black (zinc-950 page, zinc-900 fields, zinc-800 borders, zinc-500 captions), blue-600 buttons
